arxiv-2010-12676.title: A Differentiable Relaxation of Graph Segmentation and Alignment for AMR Parsing
arxiv-2010-12676.creator: Chunchuan Lyu Shay B. Cohen Ivan Titov
arxiv-2010-12676.description: Abstract Abstract Meaning Representations (AMR) are a broad-coverage semantic formalism which represents sentence meaning as a directed acyclic graph. To train most AMR parsers, one needs to segment the graph into subgraphs and align each such subgraph to a word in a sentence; this is normally done at preprocessing, relying on hand-crafted rules.

arxiv-2102-05085.title: The Use and Misuse of Counterfactuals in Ethical Machine Learning Conference: Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency; March 3–10, 2021; Virtual Event, Canada Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT ’21), March 3–10, 2021, Virtual Event, Canada Price: 15.00 D
arxiv-2102-05085.creator: Atoosa Kasirzadeh, Andrew Smart
arxiv-2102-05085.description: Abstract . The use of counterfactuals for considerations of algorithmic fairness and explainability is gaining prominence within the machine learning community and industry. This paper argues for more caution with the use of counterfactuals when the facts to be considered are social categories such as race or gender.

arxiv-2104-03250.title: Kato’s irrreducibility criterion for Kac-Moody groups over local fields
arxiv-2104-03250.creator: Auguste Hébert
arxiv-2104-03250.description: Abstract In 2014, Braverman, Kazhdan, Patnaik and Bardy-Panse, Gaussent and Rousseau associated Iwahori-Hecke algebras to Kac-Moody groups over non-Archimedean local fields. In a previous paper, we defined and studied their principal series representations. In 1982, Kato provided an irreducibility criterion for these representations, in the reductive case. We had obtained partially this criterion in the Kac-Moody case.

arxiv-2208-08810.title: Thomson decompositions of measures in the disk
arxiv-2208-08810.creator: Bartosz Malman
arxiv-2208-08810.description: Abstract We study the classical problem of identifying the structure of 𝒫 2 ​ ( μ ) \mathcal{P}^{2}(\mu) , the closure of analytic polynomials in the Lebesgue space L 2 ​ ( μ ) L^{2}(\mu) of a compactly supported Borel measure μ \mu living in the complex plane.

arxiv-2211-09464.title: Single-index mixture cure model under monotonicity constraints
arxiv-2211-09464.creator: Eni Musta, Tsz Pang Yuen
arxiv-2211-09464.description: Abstract We consider survival data in the presence of a cure fraction, meaning that some subjects will never experience the event of interest. We assume a mixture cure model consisting of two sub-models: one for the probability of being uncured (incidence) and one for the survival of the uncured subjects (latency).

arxiv-2305-11643.title: Time Optimal Ergodic Search
arxiv-2305-11643.creator: Dayi Dong, Henry Berger, and Ian Abraham
arxiv-2305-11643.description: Abstract Robots with the ability to balance time against the thoroughness of search have the potential to provide time-critical assistance in applications such as search and rescue. Current advances in ergodic coverage-based search methods have enabled robots to completely explore and search an area in a fixed amount of time.

arxiv-2310-10466.title: Hall response of locally correlated two-dimensional electrons at low density
arxiv-2310-10466.creator: Giacomo Morpurgo, Louk Rademaker, Christophe Berthod, Thierry Giamarchi
arxiv-2310-10466.description: Abstract We study the Hall constant in a homogeneous two-dimensional fluid of correlated electrons immersed in a perpendicular magnetic field, with special focus on the regime of low carrier density. The model consists of a one-band tight-binding model and a momentum-independent causal self-energy, representing interaction-induced correlations effects that are restricted to be local in space.

arxiv-2510-26753.title: Single-fluid model for rotating annular supersolids and its experimental implications
arxiv-2510-26753.creator: N. Preti, N. Antolini, C. Drevon, P. Lombardi, A. Fioretti, C. Gabbanini, G. Ferioli, G. Modugno, G. Biagioni
arxiv-2510-26753.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by N. Preti, N. Antolini, C. Drevon, P. Lombardi, A. Fioretti, C. Gabbanini, G. Ferioli, G. Modugno, G. Biagioni. The famous two-fluid model of finite-temperature superfluids has been recently extended to describe the mixed classical-superfluid dynamics of the newly discovered supersolid phase of matter. We show that for rigidly rotating supersolids one can derive a more appropriate single-fluid model, in which the seemingly classical and superfluid contributions to the motion emerge from a spatially varying phase of the global wavefunction.

europmc-pmc3257747.description: Periconceptional intake of folic acid is known to reduce a woman's risk of having an infant affected by a neural tube birth defect (NTD). National programs to mandate fortification of food with folic acid have reduced the prevalence of NTDs worldwide. Uncertainty surrounding...

pmc-10675652.title: Interplay between Vitamin D and Adipose Tissue: Implications for Adipogenesis and Adipose Tissue Function
pmc-10675652.creator: Shiqi Lu, Zhen-Bo Cao
pmc-10675652.description: Adipose tissue encompasses various types, including White Adipose Tissue (WAT), Brown Adipose Tissue (BAT), and beige adipose tissue, each having distinct roles in energy storage and thermogenesis. Vitamin D (VD), a fat-soluble vitamin, maintains a complex interplay with adipose tissue, exerting significant effects through its receptor (VDR) on the normal development and functioning of adipocytes.

pmc-11370820.title: Fluorescence nanoprobes bearing low temperature-derived biochar nanoparticles as efficient quenchers for the detection of single-stranded DNA and 17β-estradiol and their analytical potential†
pmc-11370820.creator: Xiaoli Qi, Hui Hu, Lina Liang, Yuqing Lin, Yudan Liu, Haifeng Sun, Yunxian Piao
pmc-11370820.description: Bagasse-derived biochar nanoparticles obtained under a low pyrolysis condition (400 °C) were first revealed to be capable of highly efficiently quenching the fluorescence of 6-carboxyfluorescein, with a significantly improved quenching rate constant over that of other quenchers and high-temperature prepared ones, and were designated as bagasse-derived quencher nanoparticles (BQNPs).

pmc-11414643.title: Hyaluronic Acid-Modified Micelles of Azithromycin and Quercetin Against Infections Caused by Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus Aureus
pmc-11414643.creator: Zixu Zhang, Muhan Chen, Jiahua Wang, Mo Liu, Ruibo Guo, Lu Zhang, Liang Kong, Yang Liu, Yang Yu, Xuetao Li
pmc-11414643.description: IntroductionResistance of intracellular pathogens is a challenge in microbial therapy. Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA), which is able to persist inside the cells of infected tissues, is protected from attack by the immune system and many antimicrobial agents. To overcome these limitations, nano-delivery systems can be used for targeted therapy of intracellular MRSA.

pmc-11579362.title: Profiling CARD14 gene expression in Indian Psoriasis patients
pmc-11579362.creator: S. Singh, D. Pradhan, P. Puri, Shruti Sharma, A. K. Jain
pmc-11579362.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Several Genome Wide linkage Studies on psoriasis performed to gain insight of genetic architecture of the disease. Caspase Recruitment Domain-containing family 14 (CARD14) also known as CARMA2 or BIMP2; cytogenic location: 17q25.3, is a scaffold protein that primarily controls the skin epidermis’s nuclear factor kB (NF-kB) signaling pathway activity in skin epidermis, a master gene for inflammation, has been shown to be linked with rare, heritable form of psoriasis.

pmc-11655808.title: Cortex level connectivity between ACT-R modules during EEG-based n-back task
pmc-11655808.creator: Debashis Das Chakladar
pmc-11655808.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Finding the synchronization between Electroencephalography (EEG) and human cognition is an essential aspect of cognitive neuroscience. Adaptive Control of Thought-Rational (ACT-R) is a widely used cognitive architecture that defines the cognitive and perceptual operations of the human mind. This study combines the ACT-R and EEG-based cortex-level connectivity to highlight the relationship between ACT-R modules during the EEG-based n-back task (for validating working memory performance).

pmc-12525012.title: Enhanced Collagen Prolyl 4-Hydroxylase Activity and Expression Promote Cancer Progression via Both Canonical and Non-Canonical Mechanisms
pmc-12525012.creator: Dalton Hironaka, Gaofeng Xiong
pmc-12525012.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Collagens make up the main components of the extracellular matrix (ECM), and, in cancer, are often aberrantly secreted by both tumor cells and stromal cells in the tumor microenvironment (TME). Collagen prolyl 4-hydroxylase (C-P4H), an enzyme that hydroxylates proline into 4-hydroxyproline at the Y position of the collagen -X-Y-Gly- triplet motif, is essential for the stability of the mature collagen trimer and collagen secretion.

pmc-12710230.title: Effects of hyperoxia in pediatric perfusion patients: a scoping review
pmc-12710230.creator: Mariah DeRenzo, Vanessa Velazquez-Milton, Stepney Johnson
pmc-12710230.description: Hyperoxia in pediatric cardiopulmonary bypass patients is associated with adverse effects, including reoxygenation injury, increased mortality, heightened inflammatory response, and cerebral injury. Although prior research has demonstrated a correlation between these adverse effects and hyperoxia during cardiac surgery, definitions of “hyperoxia’ vary across the literature.

pmc-13199739.title: Barriers and Facilitators to Treatment Adherence in Patients with Peripheral Artery Disease: A Qualitative Study of Patients with PAD, Relatives and Healthcare Professionals
pmc-13199739.creator: Smaragda Lampridou, Layla Bolton Saghdaoui, Gaby Judah, Alun Huw Davies, Mary Wells
pmc-13199739.description: BackgroundPeripheral artery disease (PAD) is a chronic atherosclerotic condition, affecting 20% of adults over 60 in the UK. Guideline-recommended therapy (pharmacotherapy and lifestyle change) has been shown to reduce major cardiovascular and limb events and increase life expectancy; however, adherence is low. Currently, there is a paucity of patient-centred interventions that address all aspects of adherence.

pmc-13292630.title: Sleep-related breathing disorders in children with spina bifida
pmc-13292630.creator: Kiran Nandalike, Laura J Hobart-Porter
pmc-13292630.description: PurposeThe objective of this article was to explore the prevalence, pathophysiology, diagnosis, and management of sleep-related breathing disorders (SRBDs) in children with spina bifida and specifically myelomeningocele (MMC).SummarySRBDs, including obstructive and central sleep apnea, hypoventilation, and hypoxia, are prevalent in children with spina bifida, particularly those with MMC.

pmc-13517904.title: Biomechanical Variables Associated with the First 20 m of the Start Phase in Speed Skaters
pmc-13517904.creator: Javier Gaviria-Chavarro, Miguel Ángel Gómez-García, Claudia F. Giraldo-Jiménez
pmc-13517904.description: This exploratory study examined segmental biomechanical variables associated with 20 m start performance in 24 juvenile inline speed skaters (14–16 years). Athletes performed three maximal 20 m starts; the best time was recorded with photoelectric timing gates, and the corresponding trial was analyzed from two-dimensional video using Tracker.

pmc-13613578.title: Lumbar epidural haematoma after acupuncture: a case report and review of the literature
pmc-13613578.creator: Wenbing Cao, Xing Zhang, Dongdong Li, Zhiyu Jiang
pmc-13613578.description: BackgroundAcupuncture is widely used for lumbar pain, yet needle-related spinal epidural haematoma (SEH) remains a rarely reported but potentially catastrophic complication. The lumbar segment is often assumed to be a "safe" needling zone, and the true incidence, mechanistic basis and preventive strategy for iatrogenic SEH are poorly defined.
